name: Regenerative Practice Detector
tagline: Detecting cover crop & tillage from free satellite data — open R&D.
description: In-development open research into detecting field-scale regenerative practices (cover cropping, tillage/residue) using only free, open satellite data (Google Earth Engine; Sentinel-2/-1, Landsat, AlphaEarth). Includes a runnable notebook and an at-scale validation against the Minnesota Tillage Transect Survey (~42,000 ground-truth fields): cross-validated held-out AUC ~0.78-0.83 for tillage/residue, at or above the commercial benchmark. Development and records are kept in the open here; the work is early-stage.
